title: ThinKV: Thought-Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Efficient Reasoning Models

layout.note: Panel (a) runs across the top with four equal grids; below it (b) at the left and the scatter plot (c) at the right, split by two thick black rules (one horizontal, one vertical) instead of frames.

lesson: Draw every compared method on one identical grid (rows = generation steps) with a snapshot row beneath, so the eye sees only the eviction pattern change; end with a latency-accuracy scatter whose green 'Accurate' and 'Fast' arrows mark the corner where the proposed method sits.
